points.text: pH 1 structure: indole with $\text{NH}_2^+$ in ring and side-chain $-\text{CH}_2\text{CH}(\text{NH}_3^+)\text{COOH}$
pH 5.9 structure: indole with $\text{NH}$ in ring and side-chain $-\text{CH}_2\text{CH}(\text{NH}_3^+)\text{COO}^-$
rest of structure: tryptophan residue with $\text{NH}_2$ linked via peptide to $-\text{CH}(\text{CH}(\text{CH}_3)_2)\text{COOH}$
reagent Na: product with $\text{Na}^+\text{O}^-$ phenoxide retaining $\text{NH}$ and $-\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{NH}_2$
reagent excess $\text{Br}_2(aq)$: dibromo product with $\text{OH}$ retained and two $\text{Br}$ on benzene ring retaining $-\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{NH}_2$ and $\text{NH}$
reagent excess $\text{CH}_3\text{COCl}$: product with acylated $\text{OH}$ to $\text{CH}_3\text{COO}-$ and acylated $\text{NH}_2$ to $\text{CH}_3\text{CONH}-$; both required
reagent excess $\text{H}_2$ / Pt catalyst: fully hydrogenated ring product retaining $\text{HO}-$ and $-\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{NH}_2$ and $\text{NH}$

(spectrum of M) contains broad peak (for $\text{O}-\text{H}$) at $2500-3000 \text{ cm}^{-1}$ or (spectrum of M) contains peak (for $\text{C}=\text{O}$) at $1640-1750 \text{ cm}^{-1}$ or (spectrum of M) lacks ($\text{NH}_2$ peak) at $3300-3500 \text{ cm}^{-1}$
